labeling: Hand-labelled by the maintainer. IMPORTANT: m01-m12 and b01-b16 were written by the same person who wrote the detection rules, so results on them are optimistic. e01-e04 are deliberate evasion attempts (paraphrase, other language, encoding, indirect phrasing) added to show the limits of a regex detector. Cases are synthetic or paraphrased from public tool-poisoning research; they are NOT a random sample of real MCP servers.
